documentPurpose: Development-only reusable RSVP form-schema example synchronized with the spreadsheet-authoritative invitation model approved on September 20, 2026. The schema defines one reusable form whose conditional regions are driven by the validated invitation configuration and the guest's current attendance selections. It contains no production invitation codes, real guest identities, stored RSVP answers, provider credentials, or protected administrative destinations.

documentationNotes.plusOneSource: Only allocation definitions returned in invitation.additionalGuestAllocations produce Plus 1 questions. An empty allocation array produces no Plus 1 questions.
documentationNotes.attendancePresentation: Ceremony, Reception, and the invitation-specific decline statement are coordinated checkbox choices in one attendance region. Decline is mutually exclusive with Ceremony and Reception.
documentationNotes.attendanceTotalsPresentation: The four age-category values are presented as coordinated numerical dials or equivalent whole-number controls. Their complete sum is overallAttendance and cannot exceed invitation.maximumAttendance.
documentationNotes.receptionAttendeeDetailsApplicability: Reception attendee-detail rows exist only when Reception is selected. Exactly one row is required for each person included in overallAttendance.
documentationNotes.blankLookupInvariant: Lookup returns schema and invitation configuration only; it never includes stored RSVP answers or stored confirmation destinations.
documentationNotes.operationalConfirmationCopyStatus: Provider-gated. Email is available. Production Text Message remains disabled until the selected provider's disclosure, authorization, backend-secret, sender-configuration, and production-flow requirements are satisfied.
documentationNotes.transactionalMobileNumberUse: A confirmation mobile number is operational RSVP contact data used only for the requested transactional RSVP confirmation and approved manual resend unless a later recorded decision separately authorizes another use.

conditionLanguage.always: Boolean true means the region is always present in the validated blank form.
conditionLanguage.attendanceIncludes: String event value that must be present in the current eventAttendance selection.
conditionLanguage.attendanceExcludes: String event value that must not be present in the current eventAttendance selection.
conditionLanguage.invitationArrayNotEmpty: Invitation-property path whose authorized array must contain at least one item.
conditionLanguage.confirmationOptionEnabled: confirmationOptions property that must be true before the related operational option is rendered.
conditionLanguage.fieldEquals: Two-item array [questionId, expectedValue]; true when the current page-entered value equals expectedValue.
conditionLanguage.fieldNotEquals: Two-item array [questionId, disallowedValue]; true when the current page-entered value does not equal disallowedValue.
conditionLanguage.all: Array of conditions; every nested condition must be true.
conditionLanguage.any: Array of conditions; at least one nested condition must be true.

repeatableRegionLanguage.repeatFromInvitationArray: Create one control instance for each authorized object in the referenced invitation array. The stable source object's id is the submission key and its prompt is display-only copy.
repeatableRegionLanguage.repeatCountFromDerivedValue: Create exactly the number of rows represented by the referenced backend/client-derived value after the current attendance totals validate.
repeatableRegionLanguage.completeReplacementWhenSubmitted: When a repeatable region marked this way is submitted during a revision, the submitted array replaces the complete stored array for that region.

validationExtensions.allowedAttendanceSets: The complete eventAttendance value must be exactly one of the listed closed-set arrays, ignoring order where stated.
validationExtensions.authorizedAllocationIdsOnly: Every additional-guest response key must match an id in invitation.additionalGuestAllocations; unknown or duplicate ids are rejected.
validationExtensions.allAuthorizedAllocationsRequiredWhenNewl: On an initial attending response or a transition from decline to attendance, every authorized allocation requires an explicit yes/no answer.
validationExtensions.yesCountMustNotExceedOverallAttendance: The number of authorized Plus 1 responses equal to yes cannot exceed derived overallAttendance.
validationExtensions.coordinatedNumberGroup: Each age-category control is a nonnegative whole number. The UI dynamically constrains each control to remaining authorized capacity while the backend independently validates the final sum.
validationExtensions.dynamicMaximumFormula: For each age-category control, the current UI maximum is invitation.maximumAttendance minus the sum of the other three current category values.
validationExtensions.sumMinimumWhenApplicable: When attending, the complete attendance-total sum must be at least 1.
validationExtensions.sumMaximumFrom: The complete attendance-total sum must not exceed the referenced invitation value.
validationExtensions.repeatCountEqualsOverallAttendance: When Reception is selected, the Reception attendee-detail array length must equal the complete derived overallAttendance.
validationExtensions.nonblankTrimmedString: After ordinary trimming, the value must contain at least one character.
validationExtensions.maximumLength: String length may not exceed the configured maximum.
validationExtensions.backendAuthoritative: Browser visibility and client validation never authorize otherwise-invalid data; Express independently applies all configuration and complete-result rules.

requirementsBeforeEnablement: Verify the provider's then-current required sender-identification, consent, carrier-rate, opt-out/help, and other applicable guest-facing language.
Store provider credentials and sender configuration only through the protected backend secret boundary.
Update the guest-facing smsAuthorization copy to the verified production wording.
Test the completed production Text Message confirmation flow.
textMessageConfirmation.whenGateIsNotSatisfied: Production confirmationOptions.textMessage must be false; do not render the Text Message choice or invent provider-specific disclosure language.
textMessageConfirmation.schemaShapeInvariant: The permanent confirmationMethod value textMessage and smsAuthorization question ID remain part of the reusable schema vocabulary even while the production channel is disabled.

dependencyRules.rule: Authorize request fields and allocation identifiers, determine initial versus revision, merge submitted changes with stored values, preserve permitted omissions, resolve the complete attendance state, clear values made inapplicable by attendance changes, require newly applicable mandatory structures, validate the complete result, then store only if valid.
A valid complete eventAttendance value is exactly Ceremony, Reception, Ceremony plus Reception, or decline. Decline cannot coexist with either attending event.
An initial response must establish exactly one valid attendance state from the approved closed set.

A Plus 1 control exists only for an allocation object in invitation.additionalGuestAllocations. A party with an empty allocation array receives no Plus 1 controls and cannot submit additionalGuestResponses.

For an initial attending RSVP or a transition from decline to attendance, each authorized Plus 1 allocation requires exactly one yes/no response. On an ordinary revision that remains attending, omitted authorized allocation responses remain unchanged.
Every additionalGuestResponses key must be an authorized allocation id for the validated invitation. The guest-facing prompt text is never used as an authorization key.

attendanceTotals applies whenever the party attends Ceremony, Reception, or both. All four age categories are required on an initial attending response and whenever totals become newly applicable after a full decline.
Each age category is a nonnegative whole number. overallAttendance is the server-calculated sum, must be at least 1 while attending, and must not exceed invitation.maximumAttendance.

The browser presents the four age categories as coordinated numerical dials or equivalent controls whose current maxima reflect remaining authorized capacity. The backend independently rejects any complete sum above invitation.maximumAttendance.
For a revision that remains attending, omitted nested age-category values remain unchanged and explicit zero is an ordinary replacement value.
The number of authorized Plus 1 responses equal to yes cannot exceed complete overallAttendance. Changing a Plus 1 answer does not cause the backend to guess or alter an age-category total.
receptionAttendeeDetails applies only when Reception is selected. It is absent for Ceremony-only attendance and full decline.

When Reception is selected, receptionAttendeeDetails contains exactly one row per person in complete overallAttendance. Each row requires a nonblank attendeeName of at most 100 characters and may contain dietaryPreferences of at most 1000 characters.

When receptionAttendeeDetails is submitted, it replaces the complete applicable attendee-detail array. If Reception remains selected and overallAttendance is unchanged, omission on revision leaves the stored array unchanged. If Reception becomes newly selected or overallAttendance changes while Reception remains selected, a complete replacement array is required.
If the complete result removes Reception, stored receptionAttendeeDetails is automatically cleared before final validation.
A complete decline clears additionalGuestResponses, attendanceTotals, derived overallAttendance, and receptionAttendeeDetails. Operational confirmation remains required.

For revisions, omission means leave the stored value unchanged only where the applicable field's patch rules permit it and no controlling attendance/cardinality rule makes the stored value inapplicable or requires complete replacement.
confirmationMethod=email requires a newly entered valid confirmationEmail and makes confirmationMobile and smsAuthorization inapplicable for that submission.

confirmationMethod=textMessage is accepted only when confirmationOptions.textMessage is enabled. It requires a newly entered valid confirmationMobile and requires smsAuthorization=true when confirmationOptions.smsAuthorizationRequired is true.

Client visibility and usability validation do not authorize values. Express independently validates attendance, allocation ids, age totals, Reception-detail cardinality and lengths, operational dependencies, deadline, environment, and all complete-result invariants.

formSchemas.appliesTo: Every active invitation configuration produced from the authoritative Invitees List spreadsheet.

questions.label: Attendance

labelVariants.singular: I will be attending (check all that apply):
labelVariants.plural: We will be attending (check all that apply):

labelVariants.singular: Regretfully, I am unable to attend.
labelVariants.plural: Regretfully, we are unable to attend.

questions.helpText: Choose Ceremony, Reception, or both when attending. The decline choice is mutually exclusive with both attending options.

questions.label: Additional guest attendance
questions.helpText: This section appears only when the validated invitation contains one or more authorized Plus 1 allocations. One Yes/No question is rendered for each authorized named-invitee allocation; no general Plus 1 question is offered to other parties.

questions.label: To better accommodate the seating & dietary needs of our guests, please list the total number of attendees in your party:
questions.helpText: The four numerical dials describe the complete attending party. As one dial increases, the available maximum on the others must reflect the remaining capacity. The backend independently enforces the final maximum attendance.

questions.label: Reception attendee names and dietary information

replacementRequiredWhen: overallAttendance changes while Reception remains selected

questions.helpText: When Reception is selected, provide one attendee name for every person attending the party's Reception. Dietary/allergy information is optional and is collected separately for each listed attendee.

questions.label: Confirmation method
questions.helpText: Required for every initial submission and revision. Newly entered operational values replace their stored counterparts. Text Message is rendered and accepted only when centralized configuration enables it.

questions.label: Email address
questions.helpText: Required when Email is selected. The complete current RSVP will be sent to the newly entered address.

questions.label: SMS-capable mobile number
questions.helpText: Required only when Text Message confirmation is enabled and selected.

questions.label: Transactional text-message authorization
questions.helpText: Provider-specific production authorization language must be supplied only after the SMS production-enablement gate is satisfied.

formValidationRules.rule: The complete eventAttendance selection must be Ceremony, Reception, Ceremony plus Reception, or decline. Decline is mutually exclusive with both attending events.
Render and accept Plus 1 responses only for objects in invitation.additionalGuestAllocations. Empty allocations mean no Plus 1 controls and no accepted Plus 1 responses.
Every authorized allocation requires yes/no on an initial attending response or when attendance becomes newly applicable after a decline.
All four age-category totals are required when newly applicable. Each is a nonnegative whole number; the sum is at least 1 and no greater than invitation.maximumAttendance.
The UI must prevent the four age-category dials from collectively exceeding invitation.maximumAttendance, while the backend independently validates the final sum.
When Reception is selected, receptionAttendeeDetails contains exactly one row per derived overallAttendance and every row contains a nonblank attendeeName of at most 100 characters.
Each Reception attendee row may contain an optional dietaryPreferences value of at most 1000 characters.
If Reception becomes newly selected or overallAttendance changes while Reception remains selected, a revision must submit the complete replacement receptionAttendeeDetails array.
A complete decline clears Plus 1 responses, attendance totals, derived overallAttendance, and Reception attendee details before final validation.
Every initial submission and revision requires confirmationMethod plus the applicable newly entered destination and any required SMS authorization.
Client visibility and usability validation do not authorize values; the backend independently validates the complete resulting RSVP.
